topic: Higher-education costs — student fees, cost of living and student accommodation (the AMLÉ "Fuck the Fees; Fund Our Future" march)
scale: over 3,000 students per AMLÉ, over 1,500 marched per RTÉ; described as the largest student demonstration in a decade
quote1: More than 1,500 students have marched in the centre of Dublin to protest over student fees, the effect the cost of living is having on their education and a lack of accommodation choices.
quote2: Today, thousands of students marched from the Garden of Remembrance to the Dáil to protest the cost of college in Ireland.
